messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up: agenda tweak for today's all-hands. Roadmap moved earlier by ~8m. Also our recorder failed on the first test. AV team, can someone check?
Luca: I'm at the room. Recorder log shows /dev/snd busy when laptop connects via USB-C hub. Temporary: switch to room PC and disable laptop power saving.
Rae: I have a backup OBS capture ready. Can someone DM me the emergency RTMP key?
Priya: DMing RTMP key to @Rae and @Luca now. Use rtmp://stream.redwood-infer.example/live + key.
Ben: Caption service threw 503 on the preview. OpsBot, can we fail to SRT fallback?
OpsBot: caption-service: restarting on infra-caption-01; fallback SRT endpoint srt://fallback.redwood-infer:9999.
Luca: Switched presenter to room mic; audio looks stable. Recommend we run slides from room PC.
Priya: Uploading roadmap PDF to #all-hands-assets and pinning. Note: pricing slide has draft numbers, will call out during the talk.
Rae: Local backup record started with ffmpeg -i rtmp://local -c copy ah_backup.mp4. Captions flowing on fallback.
Priya: Please drop one-line roadmap Qs here (team tag) so we can triage live. We'll answer what we can and follow up on the rest.
Ben: Q: Is there a planned Dedicated->Private migration path or manual steps? (Platform)
Luca: Monitoring recorder and captions. Ping me if anything drops.
Priya: Great, proceeding in ~3m. Add follow-ups now or flag with :raised_hand: during the Q&A.
